def test_user_registration_and_profile():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # 1. Register User
    payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    user_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert user_id == username

    # Follow-up GET User
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{user_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 2. Login User
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 3. Add Address
    addr_payload = {
        "street": "123 Main St",
        "number": "42",
        "country": "USA",
        "city": "Anytown",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "userID": user_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Follow-up GET Address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("city") == "Anytown"

    # 4. Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123",
        "userID": user_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Follow-up GET Card
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("expires") == "12/25"

def test_carts_lifecycle():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Get an item from catalogue first
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    # 1. Add item to cart
    payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Follow-up GET
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) > 0
    assert any(item.get("itemId") == item_id for item in cart_items)

    # 2. Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Follow-up GET
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_creation():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # 1. Create User
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={
        "username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": f"{username}@example.com", "firstName": "A", "lastName": "B"
    }, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 2. Create Address
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json={
        "street": "123", "number": "1", "country": "UK", "city": "Lon", "postcode": "123", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 3. Create Card
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json={
        "longNum": "1234567890123456", "expires": "12/25", "ccv": "123", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 4. Add item to cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cat_items = resp.json()
    item_id = cat_items[0]["id"]

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={
        "itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0
    }, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # 5. Create Order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order_data = resp.json()
    order_id = order_data.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order_data.get("payment", {}).get("authorised") is True

    # Follow-up GET Order
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("id") == order_id

    # Follow-up GET Orders by Customer
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    embedded = resp.json().get("_embedded", {})
    customer_orders = embedded.get("customerOrders", [])
    assert len(customer_orders) > 0

def test_payment_authorization():
    order_id = f"ord_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    payload = {
        "orderId": order_id,
        "amount": 50.0,
        "customer": {"firstName": "John", "lastName": "Doe"},
        "address": {"city": "London", "country": "UK", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "Baker"},
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"}
    }
    # 1. Authorize Payment
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth_data = resp.json()
    assert auth_data.get("authorised") is True

    # Follow-up GET
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth_list = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(auth_list, list)
    assert len(auth_list) > 0
    assert auth_list[0].get("orderId") == order_id
